# Method Financial

> Method is the infrastructure layer for consumer liability data and payments. Businesses use Method's single API to connect to 15,000+ financial institutions, access real-time consumer liability data, and initiate payments — all with a single user authentication using just a phone number (no credentials required). For complete marketing site content in a single file, see [Full Site Content](https://methodfi.com/llms-full.txt). For complete API documentation, see [API Docs](https://docs.methodfi.com/llms.txt).

Founded in 2022 (Y Combinator W20). Series B ($42M led by Emergence Capital). Based in Austin, TX.

## How Method Works

Unlike aggregators that require users to share bank login credentials, Method uses a fundamentally different approach. When a user verifies their identity, Method's network automatically discovers all their liabilities — credit cards, auto loans, student loans, mortgages, personal loans, and more — without any manual account entry or credential sharing. Once discovered, Method retrieves real-time data directly from financial institutions and can initiate payments to any creditor.

## Products

### Connect

- [Method Connect](https://methodfi.com/products/connect): Link all consumer credit and liability accounts with a single auth. No credentials needed. Evergreen connections that never break.
- [Connect API Documentation](https://docs.methodfi.com/guides/concepts): Core concepts for entities, identity verification, and account discovery.
- [Opal (Embedded UI)](https://docs.methodfi.com/guides/opal): Drop-in, white-labeled UI that handles identity verification and account discovery. Go live in days, not weeks.

### Data

- [Method Data](https://methodfi.com/products/data): Real-time liability data across 15,000+ FIs — balances, due dates, APRs, credit limits, transactions, card details, property data, and 300+ behavioral attributes.
- [Data API Documentation](https://docs.methodfi.com/reference/accounts/updates/overview): Real-time account updates with normalized fields.
- [Attributes](https://docs.methodfi.com/guides/additional-products/attributes): Structured financial metrics — utilization, payment behavior, delinquency, APR, and opportunity scoring at entity and account level.
- [Card Brands](https://docs.methodfi.com/reference/accounts/card-brands/overview): Card art, network, co-brand name, and product details for checkout and rewards experiences.
- [Transactions](https://docs.methodfi.com/reference/accounts/transactions/overview): Near-real-time credit card transaction data including merchant, time, and amount.

### Pay

- [Method Pay](https://methodfi.com/products/pay): Initiate payments to any consumer liability account. Loan payoffs, bill pay, balance transfers with real-time tracking from pending to posted.
- [Payments API Documentation](https://docs.methodfi.com/reference/payments/overview): Create, track, and manage payments to creditors.
- [Payment Instruments](https://docs.methodfi.com/reference/accounts/payment-instruments/overview): Tokenized card credentials for checkout and payment workflows. Keep your existing ACH rails.

## Solutions

- [Consumer Lenders](https://methodfi.com/solutions/consumer-lenders): Personalized offers, embedded direct pay, balance transfers, and streamlined payment operations.
- [Banks](https://methodfi.com/solutions/banks): Real-time account connectivity for loan payoffs during origination.
- [Credit Unions](https://methodfi.com/solutions/credit-unions): Member-centric lending with pre-qualified offers powered by real-time data.
- [Auto Lenders](https://methodfi.com/solutions/auto-lenders): Auto loan refinancing and payoff with VIN-level vehicle data.
- [Personal Finance](https://methodfi.com/solutions/personal-finance): Comprehensive debt dashboards, credit health monitoring, and bill pay.
- [User Engagement](https://methodfi.com/solutions/user-engagement): Drive retention with real-time financial insights and alerts.
- [Wallet Onboarding / Card Connect](https://methodfi.com/solutions/card-connect): Instant card linking with branded card art, tokenized credentials for checkout.
- [Checkout & Loyalty](https://methodfi.com/solutions/loyalty-and-rewards): Card-linked offers, rewards enrollment, and transaction monitoring.
- [Employer Benefits](https://methodfi.com/solutions/employer-benefits): Financial wellness and debt management for employee benefit platforms.
